chunks: Abu Hisham al-Basri narrated from al-Ridha عليه السلام that he said:
Among corruption are the cutting of the dirham and the dinar, and the discarding of date pits.

key_terms.الدِّرْهَمِ: the dirham; a silver coin used as currency
key_terms.الدِّينَارِ: the dinar; a gold coin used as currency
key_terms.النَّوَى: date pits; the stones of dates
key_terms.الْفَسَادِ: corruption; harmful disorder in social and material affairs

ai.seo_question: What kinds of actions does Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام describe as forms of corruption?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies certain wasteful and socially harmful practices as forms of فساد. It points to economic disruption through damaging currency and to needless waste through throwing away date pits, highlighting concern for preservation of value and proper use of resources.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3625 - Abu Hisham al-Basri narrated from Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) that he said:
"Among the causes of corruption are the discontinuation of currency (dirham and dinar) and the discarding of date pits."
